artifact.title: BigBear.ai Accession-Level Point-in-Time Revision Ledger — 2025 Restatement
artifact.creator: AhaSignals

researchQuestion: Which primary-statement values were available, withdrawn from reliance and later restated at each SEC acceptance time?

completenessBoundary.definition: Every non-zero issuer-labelled error-correction adjustment carried by the SEC filing's RestatementAxis in Note 2 and Note 25 primary-statement tables.
includedNotes: Note 2 — Restatement of Previously Issued Financial Statements
Note 25 — Restatement of Quarterly Financial Information (Unaudited)
exclusions: Dimensional facts outside the primary-statement restatement tables
Facts that cannot be uniquely assigned to previously reported, adjustment and restated states

knowledgeStates.admissibility: eligible subject to the source filing and decision time
quarantined; prior values are not reliable and restated values are not yet public
restated values eligible from the Form 10-K acceptance time

identity.label: Net increase (decrease) in fair value of derivatives

pointInTimePolicy.beforeNonReliance: Use the latest previously reported value whose SEC acceptance time is on or before the decision time.
pointInTimePolicy.afterNonRelianceBeforeRestatement: Quarantine the affected value. Do not use the prior value as reliable and do not backfill the not-yet-published restated value.
pointInTimePolicy.afterRestatement: The restated value becomes eligible from the restated Form 10-K acceptance timestamp.

limitations: Completeness means every non-zero issuer-labelled error-correction adjustment in the primary-statement restatement tables in Notes 2 and 25 of the 2024 Form 10-K. It does not mean every narrative disclosure or every tagged fact in the filing.
The ledger records the values as presented in the issuer restatement tables. A source link does not imply that SEC staff verified the accounting conclusion.

Company Facts is a secondary verification layer. Custom-taxonomy values, issuer-derived fourth-quarter cells and some prior-accession facts may not be returned there; those cells remain directly evidenced by the restated Form 10-K.
SEC acceptance timestamps establish public availability, not the time every investor processed the filing.
The ledger tests point-in-time data integrity. It does not estimate alpha, portfolio return or investment value.
Research and education only; not investment, trading, legal, accounting or tax advice.
